ingredients.title: Sauce
items: 1 1/2 lb ground beef or Italian sausage

instructions.title: Sauce
items: Add the rest of the ingredients and let simmer while the other layers are prepared.

instructions.title: Layers
items: Line a 9x13-inch pan with foil and spray with cooking spray.
Layer bottom of pan with uncooked lasagna noodles.
Add half the filling and a layer of cheese slices. Cover with half of the sauce.
Repeat layers and sprinkle top with Parmesan cheese.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour and 15 minutes to an hour and a half or until noodles are done.
